note: Every analysis line each Insight slot can roll, per genus, with its value range per property grade and the chance within that grade. Slots 1 and 5 roll flat offense, 2 and 8 defense, 3/6/9 accuracy/critical lines, 4 amplification (the genus Damage Boost line lives here) and 7 tolerance; genus-named lines count only against that genus. Rerolls draw a grade by the Insight level first (see genus_insight.json), then one property of that grade for the slot.
